source: 774 Resonance
target: 774 Resonantia

source: The mournful cry seemed to draw closer: “My child, Omebella, where are you?”
target: Clamor lugubris videbatur appropinquare: “Fili mi, Omebella, ubi es?”

source: Hearing the name “Omebella,” Lumian shuddered violently, snapping out of his fear-induced daze.
target: Audito nomine “Omebella,” Lumian vehementer contremuit, evadens ex stupore, quem timor excitaverat.

source: Who? Who is looking for Omebella? Why are they looking for Omebella?
target: Quis? Quis Omebellam quaerit? Cur eam quaerunt?

source: As he wondered, Lumian noticed the surrounding area growing darker, with a sense of confinement and imprisonment.
target: Dum cogitabat, Lumian animadvertit loca circumstantia obscuriora fieri, cum sensu coarctationis et captivitatis.

source: He reached out, his hands brushing against a cold, hard “wall.”
target: Protulit manum, et manus eius ad parietem frigido atque duro perveniebant.

source: He pressed himself against it, trying to peer through its cracks.
target: Se apposuit super illud, conans per fissuras eius intueri.

source: The “wall” was pitch black but semi-transparent, and Lumian could faintly see the pale-white sky, the collapsed towers, and the shattered palaces.
target: Paries erat penitus atratus sed semi-transparens, et Lumian tenuiter videre poterat caelum pallido-album, turris lapsas, et palatia dilaniata.

source: He also saw Sharron, the temperance faction demigod dressed in a small bonnet and a Gothic dress, floating nearby.
target: Etiam vidit Sharron, semideum factionis temperantiae, parvo pileolo et veste Gothica indutum, prope fluitantem.

source: She extended her hand, summoning the Sword of Courage, now pale from erosion.
target: Manum extendit, evocans Gladium Fortitudinis, nunc pallide ex erosione factum.

source: Beyond Sharron, he looked down at the rubble-strewn ruins.
target: Ultra Sharron, deorsum intuebatur ruinas lapidibus sparsas.

source: A pale figure in tattered clothes was kneeling, bent over as if to crawl.
target: Figura pallida in vestimentis laceratis genu flectens, incurvata quasi repere conari.

source: The figure was trembling all over, struggling to raise its head and straighten up.
target: Figura totum tremens, conans caput levare et se erigere.

source: It was a face wearing a golden mask—his own face!
target: Facies erat, quae larvam auream gerebat—ipsa eius facies!

source: Me?
target: Ego?

source: If I’m outside, then who is here?
target: Si extra sum, quis igitur hic est?

source: Already half-conscious, Lumian felt even more bewildered.
target: Iam semiconscius, Lumian etiam magis perplectus se sensit.

source: Almost simultaneously, he saw his outside self, with charred skin peeling off, sprouting half-pale, half-chestnut feathers.
target: Fere simul, vidit se forensem, cuius cutis arsa, exfoliens, erat, et pennae dimidio pallidae, dimidio castaneae emergentes.

source: His belly writhed visibly, while wheat, mushrooms, and flowers grew from the sunlit wounds.
target: Venter eius manifeste convolabatur, dum triticum, fungi, et flores ex vulneribus sub sole illustratis crescebat.

source: Silently, Sharron leaped onto the golden mask and appeared before Lumian, placing the Sword of Courage into his hands.
target: Tacite, Sharron in larvam auream subsilavit et ante Lumian apparuit, Gladium Fortitudinis in manibus eius ponens.

source: The surge of courage instantly dispelled the fear suppressing his mind and consciousness, making his vision pale-white and no longer pitch black.
target: Impulsus fortitudinis statim sopivit metum, qui mentem ac conscientiam eius subjugabat, efficens ut visio eius pallido-alba, non iam penitus atra videretur.

source: The sense of confinement and entrapment around him also dissipated.
target: Sensus coarctationis et captivitatis circum eum quoque evanuit.

source: He raised his head higher, no longer seeing himself or using a top-down perspective.
target: Caput suum attulit altius, neque se iam ex prospectu superiori intuens.

source: His gaze fell on the black egg under the ancient Death’s corpse at the top of the main hall.
target: Aspectus eius incidit in ovum nigrum sub antiquo cadavere Mortis in summitate aulae principalis.

source: He instinctively believed he had just been inside the egg, observing the outside through its shell!
target: Instinctu credebat se modo intra ovum fuisse, externa per testam eius intueri!

source: No, it wasn’t me inside the black egg, but the part of me that lost courage and was subdued by the ancient god’s aura resonating with the creature inside the egg, sharing its senses.
target: Minime, non ego in ovo nigrum ferebam, sed pars mei quae fortitudinem amisit atque aura antiqui dei, resonans cum creatura intra ovum et eius sensus communicans, subacta est.

source: So, I “saw” the scene outside the shell, “heard” the mournful cry for Omebella, and showed signs of corruption!
target: Itaque scinam extra testam “vidi”, clamor lugubris pro Omebella “audivi”, et signa corruptionis ostendi!

source: Thinking this, Lumian quickly looked down at his body, seeing the feathers falling off, mixed with wheat, mushrooms, and flowers.
target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian celeriter intuebatur suum corpus, videns pennas decidentes, misceatas cum tritico, fungis, et floribus.

source: They had all lost their color, turning pale and dim.
target: Omnia colorem suum amisere, fiens pallida et obscura.

source: Lumian also saw his belly flattening, feeling his blood, meant to be solid as a deceased, flowing throughout his body.
target: Lumian etiam vidit ventrem suum achatam, et sensit sanguinem suum, quod ut cadaver solidum esse debebat, per totum corpus fluere.

source: Suddenly, he understood why Oxyto risked so much to nurture a fetus with undead traits and an aura of the Underworld.
target: Subito intellexit cur Oxyto tantum periculum cepisset ad fovendum fetus cum indiciis mortuorum et aura Inferorum.

source: Even with just a bit of Omebella’s bloodline, suppressed by the ancient god’s corpse, he could resonate and interact with the creature inside the black egg.
target: Etiam cum parva parte sanguinis Omebellae, a cadavro antiqui dei repressa, resonare et cum creatura intra ovum nigrum interagere poterat.

source: How much more could the bird-clawed infant, with more of the Great Mother’s gifts, fused with Paramita and the Underworld, and perhaps also with Omebella’s bloodline!
target: Quam multo amplius infans ungulis avis praeditus, cum plurimis donis Magnae Matris, cum Paramita et Inferis fusus, et fortasse etiam cum sanguine Omebellae, efficere posset!

source: If we hadn’t taken out Oxyto’s premature child in time, it might have used the resonance and interaction to merge with the creature inside the black egg, controlling it from the source, or completing its catalysis!
target: Si non extraxerimus puerum prae-maturum Oxytoni in tempore, ille resonantiam et interactionem adhibuisse potuisset ut cum creatura intra ovum nigrum confluere posset, eam ex ipso fonte regens aut catalysin suam perficiens.

source: Hmm, the premature birth meant the bird-clawed infant lacked the rank and traits, requiring extreme caution.
target: Hmm, nativitas prae-matura significabat infans ungulis avis deficere dignitate et proprietatibus, idque eximia cautela requirente.

source: Even if it reached the final step, there was a high chance of failure…
target: Etiam si ad ultimum gradum pervenisset, alta probabilitas defectus erat…

source: Now, the question is, why could the creature inside the black egg hear the ‘Mother’s’ call for Omebella…
target: Nunc quaestio est: cur creatura intra ovum nigrum vocem “Matris” pro Omebella audire posset…

source: Who exactly is Omebella’s ‘Mother’? It can’t really be the Great Mother, can it? Isn’t She always outside the barrier?
target: Quis igitur est “Mater” Omebellae? Nonne illa Magna Mater esse non potest? Num illa non semper extra claustra manet?

source: What is the relationship between the creature inside the black egg and Omebella?
target: Quae est relatio inter creaturam intra ovum nigrum et Omebellam?

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian suddenly heard a faint cracking sound.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius percurrebant, Lumian subito audivit sonum tenuem crepantem.

source: He looked up in astonishment, seeing the pale-white flames burning on the black egg dim significantly and peel away.
target: Stupefactus aspexit, et vidit flammas pallido-albas super ovum nigrum ardere, signanter attenuatas atque evellentes.

source: The black egg itself developed a noticeable fissure.
target: Ipsum ovum nigrum notabilem fissuram evolvit.

source: It seemed to be disintegrating to some extent.
target: Videbatur in aliquo gradu dissolvi.

source: The next second, the entire Pale-White Nation began to tremble.
target: Secundo sequente, tota Natio Pallido-Alba tremere coepit.

source: A deathly aura from the black egg, where the ancient Death’s corpse lay, started to emerge.
target: Aura mortifera ex ovo nigrum, in quo iacebat cadaver antiqui Mortis, incipiebat emergere.

source: Even with the Sword of Courage in hand, Lumian couldn’t help but freeze, trembling.
target: Etiam cum Gladio Fortitudinis in manu haberet, Lumian non potuit nisi congelari, tremens.

source: The surrounding palaces and towers, whether in ruins or half-collapsed, began to shake violently as if struck by an earthquake.
target: Palatia et turres circumstantes, sive in ruinis sive semi-collapsae, vehementer concuti coepere, quasi terrae motu percussae.

source: A thought flashed through Lumian’s mind: The Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace’s corpse is awakening… Run! Escape!
target: Cogitatio per mentem Lumiani fulsit: Cadaver progenitoris Phoenicis Gregrace excitatur… Fuge! Effuge!

source: He shouted this in his mind but couldn’t turn his body or take a single step.
target: Hoc in mente exclamavit, sed corpus verti nec unum quidem passum facere potuit.

source: The temperance faction demigod Sharron grabbed him, and in his eyes reflected the dim figure of the Knight of Swords, who looked much fainter than before.
target: Deum minor factionis temperantiae Sharron eum arripuit, et in oculis eius figura opaca equitis gladii reflexa est, quae multo pallidior quam ante videbatur.

source: Cracks appeared in the pale-white sky, extending towards the trembling ground.
target: Fissurae apparuerunt in caelo pallido-albo, extendentes versus terram tremens.

source: An overwhelming sense of dread was rapidly accumulating at the top of the main hall of Death.
target: Immensus sensus timoris celeriter in summitate aulae principalis Mortis accumulabatur.

source: Sharron, holding Lumian, initiated Spirit World Traversal.
target: Sharron, Lumian tenens, iter per Regnum Spirituum incepit.

source: This could be used in the Underworld but would trigger retribution.
target: Hoc in Inferis adhiberi poterat, sed ultionem excitare debebat.

source: Countless indescribable limbs reached out from the void, grabbing at the swiftly moving Sharron.
target: Innumerabiles membra ineffabilia e vacuo protraxerunt se, rapientes Sharron celeriter moventem.

source: Sharron endured the damage from these limbs, continuing to head towards the pitch-black cathedral at the edge of the Pale-white Nation.
target: Sharron toleravit damna harum membrorum, pergens versus cathedral penitus atrum in margine Nationis Pallido-Albae.

source: Her body ignited with pale-white flames, directly burning her spirit, causing clumps of powder to fall continuously.
target: Corpus eius inflammatum est in flammas pallido-albas, spiritum directe comburens, unde conglomerata pulveris continue cadere coeperunt.

source: Sharron could no longer sustain it any more than three seconds, interrupting the Spirit World Traversal and falling onto the pale-white wilderness outside the palace of Death, nearly a kilometer from the pitch-black cathedral.
target: Sharron id amplius quam tribus secundis sustinere non potuit, iter per Regnum Spirituum interrumpens et in solitudinem pallido-albam extra palatium Mortis cadens, paene uno chiliometro a cathedral penitus atro.

source: Holding the Sword of Courage, Lumian, now outside Death’s palace complex, no longer felt as afraid.
target: Gladio Fortitudinis tenens, Lumian, nunc extra complexum palatii Mortis, timorem non amplius sensit.

source: He immediately pointed at himself, indicating for Sharron to possess him.
target: Statim se ipsum indicavit, ostendens ut Sharron eum possideret.

source: At the same time, he saw numerous jagged cracks rapidly spreading from behind, revealing a bottomless darkness, spheres wrapped in blood-red substance, and mountains filled with tombs…
target: Eodem tempore, vidit numerosas fissuras acutatas celeriter se extendere ab tergo, ostendentes abyssum sine fundo, sphaeras in sanguine rubro involutas, et montes sepulcris repletos…

source: Feeling achill within him, Lumian quickly ignited in blazing white flames, transforming into a magnificent spear, and launched towards the edge of the Pale-White Nation.
target: Sentiens aciem intus, Lumian celeriter inflammatus est in flammas albas ardentes, se in hastam magnificam transformans, et ad marginem Nationis Pallido-Albae iecit.

source: Above, below, and on all sides, countless cracks chased after him like shattered glass.
target: Supra, infra, et omni parte, innumerabiles fissurae eum insequebantur, quasi vitrum confractum.

source: Behind him, from the direction of the palace, a heavy sound emerged.
target: Post eum, ex directione palatii, sonus gravis emersit.

source: Amid the pale erosion, the flaming spear disappeared and reappeared twice.
target: In medio erosionis pallidae, hasta flammans evanuit et bis re apparuit.

source: Finally, Lumian escaped the Pale-White Nation, landing in front of the towering pitch-black cathedral.
target: Postremo, Lumian Nationem Pallido-Albam effugit, incidens in conspectu ingentis cathedral penitus atri.

source: Here, only the underground portion of the cathedral was visible, resembling a massive mountain.
target: Hic, sola pars subterranea cathedral, ingenti monte similis, apparebat.

source: Lumian passed through the heavy wooden doors, once again transforming into a flaming spear and launched upwards.
target: Lumian per portas ligneas graves transivit, iterum se in hastam flammeam transformans et sursum iecit.

source: When the flames dispersed, he sheathed the Sword of Courage, climbing upwards using the collapsed stairs, peeling walls, and broken pillars, repeatedly jumping between them, sometimes leaping across support-less areas as a flaming spear.
target: Cum flammas evanuerunt, involvit Gladium Fortitudinis, ascendens sursum per scalas collapsas, parietes descidentes et columnas fractas, iterumque inter eos saliens, interdum regiones sine sustentatione transiliens, ut hasta flammea.

source: Before long, the pitch-black cathedral began to shake violently.
target: Mox, cathedral penitus atra vehementer concuti coepit.

source: The already precarious corridors, stairs, walls, and pillars started to crack and fall.
target: Illa iam instabiles, scalae, parietes, et columnae incipiebant fissuras formare et cadere.

source: Seeing himself about to be crushed and buried by the collapsing building, Lumian prepared to draw the Sword of Courage to carve out an escape route.
target: Cum vidisset se imminere constringi et sub ruentibus aedificiis sepulti futurum, Lumian praeparavit Gladium Fortitudinis extrahere ad viam evasionis sculpendam.

source: At this moment, he was surprised to find the stones and pillars above him seemed to have a life of their own, avoiding him and continuing to fall past his sides.
target: Hoc tempore, admiratus est quod lapides et columnae super eum quasi vitam propriam haberent, evitantes eum et per latera eius cadentes.

source: In such a dangerous situation, Lumian remained unharmed.
target: In tali periculo, Lumian intactus remansit.

source: He guessed Sharron provided some help, not wasting any time, and continued his ascent, repeating the process.
target: Coniectus est Sharron quandam auxilium praebuisse, nullum tempus perdit, atque ascensum suum continuavit, processum iterans.

source: After an unknown amount of time, the violent shaking abruptly stopped.
target: Post ignotum spatium temporis, concutio violenta subito cessavit.

source: Lumian didn’t relax, maintaining his pace and rhythm until he saw a pale green light above.
target: Lumian non quievit, cursum et rhythmum suum servans, donec lucem viridem pallidam supra videret.

source: A blazing white spear shot out from the dark hole within the half-collapsed church.
target: Hasta alba flammans ex foro obscuro intra ecclesiam semi-collapsam erupit.

source: With the flames dispersing, Lumian’s figure appeared, standing firmly on the cracked stone slab.
target: Cum flammas evanuerant, corpus Lumiani apparuit, firmiter stans super lapide fisso.

source: Next to a broken wall embedded with several bone torches, a tall Demon with a human-goat hybrid face slowly turned, dragging a white bone leg.
target: Iuxta parietem fractum, in quo plura luminaria ex ossibus insita erant, altus Daemon, facie humano-caprina mixta, lente se vertit, crus ossis albi trahens.

source: At that moment, Lumian realized he hadn’t retrieved the black egg, failing the Demon’s commission.
target: Illo momento, Lumian animadvertit se ovum nigrum non recuperavisse, mandatum Daemonis deficiens.

source: Instantly, anger surged within him: Was this a task I could complete?
target: Statim, ira in eo surrexit: Num hoc opus perficere possem?

source: You were sending me to my death! Truly a Demon’s commission! Fine, since completing the task is no longer an option, I have only one choice: destroy the commissioner!
target: Me ad mortem mittebas! Vere mandatum Daemonis! Bene, cum opus perficere iam non possit, unum solum mihi relinquit: commissarium perimere!

source: Despite these thoughts, Lumian only reached into the Traveler’s Bag, preparing to draw the Sword of Courage, without intending to fight immediately.
target: Non obstante his cogitationibus, Lumian solum in sacculum Viatoris extendit manum, Gladium Fortitudinis extrahere praeparans, neque statim pugnare intentus.

source: He was concerned that the ancient Death’s corpse’s awakening would cause mutations to spread here, preferring to leave the depths of the Underworld as soon as possible, especially given the unknown strength of the goat-faced Demon.
target: Curabat ne excitatio antiqui cadaveris Mortis mutationes hic diffunderet, et optabat quam primum relinquere profunda Inferorum, praesertim propter ignotam potentiam Daemonis faciei caprinae.

source: Hunched over, the goat-faced Demon staggered in front of Lumian.
target: Procumbens, Daemon faciei caprinae ante Lumian titubavit.

source: It stared at Lumian silently before speaking in a hollow, decayed voice.
target: Silentiose adspiciebat Lumian, deinde in vocem cavum et corruptam loqui coepit.

source: This time, it used Dutanese: “You’ve taken that egg for yourself!”
target: Hoc tempore, Dutanice dixit: “Tu tibi ipsi ovum abstulisti!”

source: Before it finished speaking, the goat-faced Demon straightened its four or five-meter-tall body and swung the white bone leg at Lumian.
target: Priusquam finiret loqui, Daemon faciei caprinae corpus suum, quod quattuor aut quinque metrorum altum erat, rectificavit et crus ossis albi in Lumian iactavit.
